literal_meaning: কাজের ডাণ্ডা বা লাঠি (work's stick or rod)
figurative_meaning_en: Capable or proficient in work; skilled at tasks
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কাজে ডাঁটো মানুষ, যেকোনো কাজ সামলে নেয়।
এই গ্রামের যুবকরা সবাই কাজে ডাঁটো।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a capable person in work; he handles any task.
The young men in this village are all skilled at their jobs.
note: This idiom likely originates from rural Bengali contexts where a 'stick' symbolizes reliability or tool for work.
